components.name: Thumbs
components.description: Thumbs up / thumbs down feedback. Each thumb is a pressed-state toggle; picking one clears the other and can play an optional effect: a tilt, a pop, a burst of dots or floating thumbs. Up moves upward, down moves downward. Effects only play on a click, never on mount, and honour reduced motion.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Clicking the chosen thumb again clears it to `null`.

props.name: effect
props.description: Optional animation played when a thumb is picked. Defaults to `none`.

props.name: upLabel
props.description: Accessible names for the two buttons.

examples.title: counts · controlled
examples.code:
<Thumbs
  value={vote}
  onValueChange={setVote}
  counts={{
    up: BASE_COUNTS.up + (vote === "up" ? 1 : 0),
    down: BASE_COUNTS.down + (vote === "down" ? 1 : 0),
  }}
/>
